changes: Lottie artwork now uses centered uniform aspect fitting, fixing stretched recommendation art across game-over, menu and village cards.
Santa Selfie and its action icons now retain premultiplied alpha from image decoding through filtering and drawing; spray source-atop and decoration source-over blending updated consistently.
Village/card Lottie playback no longer drops fractional frame changes below half a source frame.
Selfie reuses its beard surface only when the complete visible point state and target size are identical; solver constraint iteration no longer clones lists.
Added opt-in live frame profiler; does not measure input-to-photon latency or change simulation steps.
Original action-game tutorial queues and cloud artwork translated to Rust; Ski tutorial uses original video frames with sample aspect preserved.
Pause/game-over responsive geometry matches 18 source cases, including short-landscape row layout; corrected below-content fade/translation and title punctuation.
Final opaque output pass GPU-verified: every RGB byte preserved and all final alpha bytes 255.
Added native Elf Maker and Elf Jamband, with source-state/geometry/animation comparisons.
Shared identical Shapes GPU resources to avoid Macroquad's 32-pipeline startup limit.
Maker software drop-shadow cost isolated and moved to a GPU Gaussian kernel; idle frame intervals improved to about 60 fps without changing animation clocks.
Restored the shared selector in activity scenes; Jamband and Maker hamburger/card navigation release checks pass.
Added Elf Glider with source simulation, CSS lifecycle/sprite, responsive screenshot and motion-threshold comparisons.
Added native Penguin Dash with ten source levels, real-Phaser state/body/player-frame comparisons, original video frames and responsive captures.
remaining: Eleven native scenes remain partial; 44 source scenes have no native implementation.
Other modes still need individual edge/capture checks. Existing shared edge bleed and opaque target copy remain active.
Whole-site smoothness and minimum input latency are not verified; presentation stalls contaminated post-change desktop profiles.
Cold village image/Lottie parsing and first-use Ogg decode still run on the main thread.
Overlay font raster/bold treatment, card asset loading/fades and every transition phase still need comparison.
evidence: Owned release smoke: Boatload tutorial delay/next hint, key dismissal and pause/resume; all saved output alpha 255.

agent_tracking.visibility: Only Dec 24 10:00 UTC through Dec 25 11:00 UTC (exclusive), per user request. No off-season tracker details through the visibility-gated API.
agent_tracking.progress: 420-stop original route schedule, year skew, great-circle interpolation, distance, heading, presents, stop timings and nearest-stop calculations translated to Rust; 3,020 source states and seasonal boundaries tested. Native tracker controller now includes one-second adjusted clock, marker visibility and active/20 fading trails, current/temporary destination selection, visited feed-stop IDs, 20-second auto-refocus, source camera zoom/pan commands, mobile gesture controls and exact English stats formatting. 3,020 original StopManager states, 18 controller states, 12 clock adjustments and formatter/nearest-arrival cases match. Photo attribution metadata is retained in typed route details.
remaining: Native map and tracker screen are not implemented; controller commands are available to a future native renderer.
Google Maps tiles/overlays, feed/media playback, photo loading/animation, persistent route cache, remote config, online refresh and native geolocation remain unfinished.
